Topics covered in this PDF

BCOE-141 (Principles of Marketing) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Marketing in a developing economy, marketing regulations in India, market segmentation, product line strategies, the product life cycle
  • Buying process for a TV, going rate pricing, pricing under the Consumer Protection Act 2019, channels of distribution, push and pull strategy, packaging, personal selling, discounts, total system and total cost approaches

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment, course title Principles of Marketing, coverage all blocks, maximum marks 100, attempt all questions. Section A: five questions (10 each). Section B: five questions (6 each). Section C: Q11 and Q12, each carrying 10 marks with two parts

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
